chapter: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body
subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la balanced diet, nutrients, vitamins, minerals, roughage, food tests, millets matrum mindful food choices-ai kathukkolvom. Food namma body-ku energy, growth, repair kudukkudhu; variety-ana healthy food mukkiyam.
learning_objectives: Balanced diet-na enna-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, roughage-oda roles-ai identify panna mudiyum.
Vitamin C deficiency matrum scurvy connection-ai describe panna mudiyum.
Food items-la nutrients identify panna basic tests-ai explain panna mudiyum.
Millets matrum local foods-oda nutrition value-ai solla mudiyum.
Healthy eating habits matrum mindful food choices suggest panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Healthy eating-na enna?
teaching_sequence.caption: Healthy body-ku wholesome food, correct quantity, suitable season/time mukkiyam. Balanced diet-la different food groups irukkum; oru type food mattum saapittaa ella nutrients kidaikkaadhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Medu-um Mishti-um saapadra food-ai compare pannunga. Taste mattum illa; body-ku enna nutrients kidaikkudhu-nu yosippom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Balanced diet-na enna? Oru meal-la different food groups yen include pannanum?

teaching_sequence.title: Food groups matrum nutrients
teaching_sequence.caption: Carbohydrates, fats energy kudukkum; proteins growth-um repair-um help pannum. Vitamins, minerals body functions support pannum. Roughage digestion-ku help pannum; water-um essential.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Rice, millets, pulses, milk, vegetables, fruits ellam different nutrients kudukkum. Variety-aa saapitta body-ku pala nutrients kidaikkum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Protein body-ku enna help pannum? Carbohydrates-oda main role enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Vitamin C matrum scurvy
teaching_sequence.caption: Long sea voyages-la fresh fruits illaama irundha sailors-ku bleeding gums, swollen gums vandhadhu. Citrus fruits-la irukkura vitamin C scurvy-ai prevent panna help pannum. Food variety deficiency diseases-ai avoid panna help pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Lemon, orange madhiri fruits vitamin C sources. James Lind observations sailors-oda health-um citrus fruits-um connect pannina example.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Vitamin C deficiency nala varra disease enna? Vitamin C kudukkura rendu foods sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Vitamins, minerals, roughage
teaching_sequence.caption: Fruits, green vegetables, milk, whole grains vitamins and minerals kudukkum. Roughage undigested food move aaga help panni bowel movement smooth-aa irukka support pannum. Water digestion-kku mukkiyam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Daily meals-la greens, fruits, whole grains include pannunga. Roughage energy kudukkaadhu; aana gut movement-ku help pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Roughage-oda role enna? Vitamins and minerals kidaikkura food examples sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Food-la nutrients test pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Iodine test starch presence-ai kaattum; classroom tests protein/fat-ai identify panna help pannalaam. Tests teacher supervision-la safe-aa seiyanum; chemicals taste panna koodadhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Textbook activity-la sample food-ai test pannumbodhu colour change observe pannuvom. Test result enna indicate pannudhu-nu record pannunga; colour mattum paathu overclaim panna vendaam.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Iodine test starch irundhaa enna change kaattum? Food test-la safety yen important?

teaching_sequence.title: Millets matrum energy balance
teaching_sequence.caption: Millets nutrition-rich cereals. Ragi, kambu, thinai madhiri local millets fibre matrum nutrients provide pannum. Excess sugar/fat high calories kudukkalaam; balanced portions mukkiyam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Local millets-ai other foods-oda compare pannunga. Oru food healthy-aa irukkaradhu portion size-um overall diet-um poruththu irukkum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Millets-oda oru nutrition benefit sollunga. High sugar/fat food-ai yen moderate-aa saapidanum?

teaching_sequence.title: Food choices across regions
teaching_sequence.caption: India-la region, season, cultivation, culture, availability base-la food habits differ aagum. Local, seasonal foods variety-ana diet-ku contribute pannum. Food choice health-um environment-um affect pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru region-la rice common; vera place-la millet alladhu wheat common. Different food habits-ai judge pannaama nutrients, availability, balance base-la understand pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Food habits region-ku region yen maarum? Local seasonal food-oda oru benefit sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Mindful eating recap
teaching_sequence.caption: Mindful eating-na hunger, fullness, food quality, portion, variety-ai notice panni choose pannuradhu. Balanced meals, clean water, regular habits, junk food moderation health-ai support pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Saapdumbodhu screen avoid panni, food-ai slow-aa chew panni, body signals-ai notice pannunga. Healthy choice daily small decisions-la build aagum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Mindful eating-la follow panna koodiya rendu habits sollunga. Balanced diet yen mukkiyam?
